purpose: Add a convenient extra action while already doing something else.
keywords: Verb dictionary / past form + ついでに; noun + のついでに
While I was out going to the post office, I bought some bread.
I will stop at the library while I am out shopping.
After tidying the shelf, I took the opportunity to wipe the window too.
formation: Verb dictionary / past form + ついでに; noun + のついでに
restrictions: The extra action is secondary and convenient on that occasion.
mistake: It is not simply simultaneous action; use ながら when two actions overlap in time.
